title: Claw Body
subtitle: #930-003 · revised render of 930-003_ClawBody.scad (designed, no reference mesh) · feature names

labels.text: U1 upper plate over the span XL-320: level underneath at the pads' height, with nothing cut into it
M1 MR128 seats, blind: the bearings go in from the inside, under a 1 cover
L1 shelf joining U1 to K1, raised with U1's underside; the tongue under it in V1's groove
K1 lower plate, its rear face S3's
C1 column sleeve round S1 and S2, flat in front, 1 in front of S1
W1 wall, 2.5 all round, its outline claw_shell_path(), the cap's too: symmetric about the roll axis
W1's level bottom, z 6.512, over the Span Mount's base plate
S4 span bolts ×2: the M2 × 12s go in from here, through K1, the Span Mount and the servo's tab, each head on K1's front face
R1 tapered rim, into the cap's groove, the wall's shoulder outside it
O1 opening, pillar to pillar, y -4 to the seam: the Claw Finger Wall fills it
G1 end grooves ×2, into the upper pillars' blends, open forward, for the wall's end lips
G2 rear groove, behind the opening, for the wall's rear lip
P1 pinion tunnel through K1: the pinion goes in from the front
D1 pillars ×4, blended R5 into W1, with T1 tapped for the cap's M3 × 10s

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. Its socket on the Span Mount is ../900-ToolInterface/span_socket.scad's, shared with the Static Finger, its outline is claw_gears.scad's, shared with the Claw Cap, and its layout along y is claw_params.scad's. It prints standing on the upper plate's rear face, open upward, with supports under the lower plate and the shelf only. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
